_about: Two water listings of the development market Larchmere, read live on 22 October 2026
with the gated user agent in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63, .venv-naive): each page's
accessibility snapshot, its 'main' region only, as the browser tool builds its snapshot
(the tool adds [ref=...] to each node), once the page's script had filled in the pack
menu ('populated') and once before it had ('early'), and the menu as the DOM's select
holds it, for the menu reader's tests (tests/test_box.py, PackMenus). igr-dev-23 has a
sold-out pack; igr-dev-16 lists two of the four packs.
